name: borabu
text: borabu names the horn of the Fianna. Oisín discovered the horn beneath a stone; its coils swept round like a sea-shell. One blast on the borabu drew fighting men from every quarter of Ireland without delay.

attributes.attribute: horn of the Fianna; one blast summons warriors from every part of Ireland

okr.objective: Identify borabu as the horn of the Fianna and its summoning power.
key_results: Names the horn of the Fianna as borabu.
Records Oisín's discovery of the horn under a stone.
States that one blast summons warriors from every part of Ireland.
